$Comment: The library's sample stance, switched off: turn it on in mods/ziggfreedcommon/track-stances.json with { "Zc_Track_Example_Stance": { "Enabled": true } }, beside the sample track and its picks Zc_Track_Example_Stance_Rooted, _Fleet and _Key in track-picks.json. Rooted and Fleet are its two faces, one of each kind: owned for good once learned, but what each grants counts only while it is held in a slot. Slot I is open from the start; slot II opens once the player owns the key pick (a TaughtOnly pick: /zigtrack pick --pick=Zc_Track_Example_Stance_Key, or a Pick reward). Each kind may be held once at a time and costs two health while held. Releasing one costs a copper bar; holding is free. Try it with /zigtrack stance hold --stance=Zc_Track_Example_Stance --face=Zc_Track_Example_Stance_Rooted, or open it with the Track_Stance destination.
